is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles funestus s.s. (page 5, 'Mosquito collections' and page 7, 'Mosquito Collections').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for kdr 1014F (Vgsc L995F), kdr 1014S (Vgsc L995S), and Ace-1 119S (Ace-1 G280S) by PCR (page 5, 'Resistance mechanisms' and Table 3, page 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 (page 7) gives exact genotype counts (FF, LF, LL for kdr; rr, rs, ss for iACE) for An. gambiae s.s. from Kitwe (41 FF, 0 LF, 0 LL; 41 ss) and Kasama (16 FF, 8 LF, 2 LL; 25 ss).

african_field_population.evidence: Adult female mosquitoes were collected resting indoors in private dwellings from 54 localities across Zambia between March 2011 and April 2013 (page 5).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research study reporting original field collections, bioassay data, and molecular/transcriptomic assays.

sub_country_location.evidence: Table 3 reports data at the district level (Kitwe and Kasama), and 54 specific collection localities across districts are detailed in Table S1.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected between March 2011 and April 2013 (page 5), a 2-year window.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Collections were part of national insecticide resistance monitoring by the National Malaria Control Centre supported by PMI/ZISSP; no indication of published duplication of the 2011-2013 genotype data.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts are reported in Table 3 in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and underlying resistance mechanisms in Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles funestus s.s. across Zambia between 2011 and 2013. Target-site resistance genotyping (Vgsc L1014F, L1014S, and Ace-1 G119S) was performed on An. gambiae s.s. F0 females from Kitwe and Kasama districts, revealing high frequencies of 1014F (fixed in Kitwe) and an absence of 1014S and 119S.
